condition: In React Native on Hermes (or with the formatjs Intl polyfill), the dayjs timezone plugin's .tz() throws a RangeError or returns null, because it depends on Intl time-zone support and on toLocaleString('en-US', { timeZone }).
workaround: Add the formatjs Intl polyfills, then patch Date.prototype.toLocaleString so that it uses Intl.DateTimeFormat with explicit 2-digit fields and hour12: false whenever only a timeZone option is passed. Another option is the Intl variant of JSC on Android.
